DrawingPrizes.title: Exciting Announcement: The First Drawing
DrawingPrizes.textOne: We are thrilled to announce that we will be holding our first drawing this September! Get ready for a chance to win incredible prizes, including cruises, vacations, and even automobiles.
DrawingPrizes.textThree:
- **Prizes to be Confirmed:** While we are planning to offer amazing prizes such as cruises, vacations, and automobiles, please note that the final prize list has not yet been secured.
- **Subject to Change:** All prize details are subject to change, and we will provide updates as soon as they are confirmed.
DrawingPrizes.textFour:
All members who download the app are eligible for the drawing. Learn how to increase your chances by earning entries through the following activities:

- **App Activity:** For every day you actively use the app, you receive 1 entry.
- **Accept a Hello Invitation:** Receive 30 entries.
- **Take a Selfie:** Earn 20 entries.
- **Accept a Hello Chat Request:** Gain 50 entries.
DrawingPrizes.textFive:
- **Entries Validity:** Entries are good for one drawing and do not roll over unless you complete a combination of the following activities 10 times within a 30-day period:

1. Visit a Hello Hangout
2. Share the app
3. Attend a Hootsa
4. Create a Hootsa

**Rollover Entries:** If you complete the combination of these activities 10 times within a 30-day period, your points will roll over.

### Stay Active and Increase Your Chances! Keep using the app and participating in these activities to maximize your entries and increase your chances of winning!

Disclaimer:
*The prizes mentioned above are tentative and subject to change. Final prizes will be announced once they are confirmed. Participation in the drawing is subject to the official rules, which will be provided at a later date. No purchase necessary to enter or win. Void where prohibited.*

Embassadordetails.text: Are you interested in an amazing gig? Become a **Hello Ambassador** and be a part of the Say Hello movement!
Embassadordetails.textone: We need your help to sign up thousands of businesses eager to be part of the Say Hello movement and create memories, not just transactions. As a Hello Ambassador, you’ll earn $50 for each business you sign up, plus enjoy recurring benefits. This is a flexible opportunity where you can reach out to your local businesses at your own pace and convenience.
Embassadordetails.texttwo:
**Competitive Pay:** Earn $50 for every business you sign up.
- **Recurring Benefits:** Receive $20 for each year the business re-signs.
- **Flexibility:** Work on your own schedule and manage your own methods.
- **No Experience Required:** Previous experience in sales or business recruitment is a plus but not necessary.
Embassadordetails.textthree:
- **Identify and Contact Potential Businesses:** Join the Say Hello movement.
- **Explain Membership Benefits:** Present the advantages of our membership to business owners and decision-makers.
- **Sign Up Businesses:** Complete the sign-up process for new business members.
- **Represent Our Brand:** Wear our company-branded shirt during recruitment activities (encouraged but not mandatory) to promote our brand and establish a professional image.
Embassadordetails.textfour: If you're excited about this opportunity and want to join us as a Hello Ambassador, follow these simple steps to apply:
Embassadordetails.textsix: - Provide your full name, address, phone number, email, and Social Security number (for tax purposes).
Embassadordetails.texteight: - Indicate your acknowledgment to wear the company-branded shirt during business recruitment activities by checking the appropriate box.
Embassadordetails.textten:
Upload the completed W-9 form.
- Upload the signed Independent Contractor Agreement.
- (Optional) Upload a recent photograph for identification purposes.
Embassadordetails.texteleven:
Review all the provided information.
- Tap "Submit Application" to complete your application.

InfluncerIntro.textone: We’re reaching out to invite you to become a part of something exciting and impactful – the Say Hello Movement! We believe your unique voice and platform can help us bring businesses and people together in a way that goes beyond transactions and creates real, lasting connections. What’s in it for you?
InfluncerIntro.textthree:
As a Say Hello Influencer, you’ll be helping us grow our community by introducing businesses to the platform and recruiting Hello Ambassadors to join the movement. Here’s what you can expect:
• Earn $100 for every business that becomes a Say Hello member through your outreach.
• Ongoing Earnings: Receive $50 each year for every business re-sign, creating a passive income stream.
• Ambassador Referral Bonus: Earn 10% of what each Ambassador earns when they use your code to sign up. The more they succeed, the more you earn!
InfluncerIntro.textfour:
Say Hello is more than just a platform – it’s a movement aimed at creating meaningful connections between people and real relationships between businesses and customers. We focus on connections, and we need your influence to spread the word and help us grow.

Your Role:
• Help businesses and ambassadors see the value of joining Say Hello.
• Grow Your Network & Earnings: As your influence spreads, so does your earning potential. We are absolutely sure it will be explosive. Welcome aboard!

global.alsDescription: Ten years ago, the world united for the Ice Bucket Challenge, raising $115 million to fight ALS, a terminal neuromuscular disease that causes respiratory failure. Despite the funds and awareness, ALS remains incurable. The challenge demonstrated global unity and the power of collective action. We invite you to join us by donating $29 annually to the ALS Foundation. Let's highlight our shared humanity, support local businesses, and continue the journey we started together.
